stem: A pre-use checklist requires the work area around a cart-mounted pump to be clear, but boxes block safe access. What is the best response?
choices: Correct the housekeeping issue if within routine authority before operating the equipment
Operate the pump and move boxes only if needed
Ignore the checklist because the pump itself is undamaged
rationale: Readiness includes the safe work area, not only the equipment body. Routine housekeeping hazards should be corrected before use when authorized.
